predecessor_policy: Retain v1 protocol and historical reports unchanged. Do not pool samples across versions. All v2 comparisons require fresh matched Node/native runs.
ordering: Node then Rust on odd rounds; Rust then Node on even rounds; same fixture order
bootstrap_unit: paired round; median of paired metric ratios or differences; 2.5th and 97.5th percentile interval
http_connection_policy: Identical pooled HTTP/1 driver client per implementation/workload; no retries; fully consume and compare every response. Mocks share a separate driver-owned HTTP/1 listener with persistent connections.
driver_build: Optimized release profile required for numerical runs; --validate records byte/count/cleanup checks without timing results.
validation_samples: One round, max(8, configured concurrency) warmup and max(32, configured concurrency) measured requests; retain actual driver peak in-flight requests separately from configured concurrency. Validation is functional coverage, not a timing or representative load result.
execution: Complete serve CLI process with cleared environment, private empty config, synthetic keys and loopback-only evaluator/upstream; no user configuration, live provider calls or model downloads.

fixture.selected_model: claude-sonnet-5 except large catalog retains claude-opus-5-5
fixture.stream_framing: message_start, content_block_start, declared text deltas, content_block_stop, message_delta(end_turn), message_stop; exact UTF-8 LF/LF SSE bytes

identity: Miss inputs include round/stage/index; cache input is identical; independent prompt IDs and agent ID modulo concurrency. Stream requests explicitly set stream=true. Request and expected response lengths/hashes are retained.
controls: Direct upstream runs use identical request/response fixtures before each gateway pair. Do not subtract independently measured percentiles. Every measured inference reaches upstream exactly once; misses evaluate once, warm cache zero; large catalog counts once against claude-haiku-4-5-20251001; other workloads zero. Compare the complete parsed inference/count body against the fixture with only the intended target-model/count-generation-field changes and twelve decimal request-index bytes varying. Stream producer started/fully-yielded/abandoned counts must equal measured/measured/zero; driver validates all expected bytes through EOF separately. Evaluator requests are checked for object shape and count only; exact rubric/state input parity is a separate contract suite.
body_metrics: First-body latency ends at the first nonempty DATA frame observed by the driver, separately from response headers. Compare bytes incrementally across arbitrary HTTP fragmentation with an 8MiB response bound. Per-response maximum DATA gap excludes empty frames, headers and trailers and is null when fewer than two data frames arrive. HTTP may coalesce/split source frames; this is a driver observation, not an upstream flush/stall clock. Retain raw header/body/total/gap samples, observed data-frame counts, complete response byte throughput and paired-round intervals.
latency_gates: Apply the unchanged 10% relative allowance and 0.5ms absolute noise floor to p95/p99 complete-response and first-body latency. Stream DATA gaps and response-byte throughput are descriptive; no new acceptance threshold. All comparisons remain unqualified on uncontrolled hardware.
resources: Whole-process idle and 100ms sampled RSS plus ps CPU delta retain v1 scope and resolution rules. True peak RSS, allocations and file descriptors remain null/unqualified. Producer completion is last data yielded, not successful downstream forwarding; exact driver EOF verification is a separate requirement.
startup_limits: Warm filesystem/OS-cache process startup; no cold reboot/cache purge or npm dispatcher timing.
environment: Record source/toolchain/binary/fixture hashes, CPU/OS/RAM, power settings, worker counts and load. Driver two Tokio workers; native one current-thread executor; runtime background workers remain part of whole-process observations. Do not collect process names, secrets or private paths.
acceptance_limits: No numeric v2 evidence exists at declaration. Streaming adds successful full-response coverage only. Backpressure/cancellation/failure timing, resource soak, storage/history/status, processing-only latency, peak memory, allocations, representative hardware and real-provider quality remain open. No changed thresholds or pooling historical results.
